Primary request: produce the redesigned ARTICLE DETAIL page in the same light pale-blue design system and SAME 525 CSS px reading width as Image1. Give article body, collection navigation and comments a clear gentle hierarchy. Use a couple of fine 1px light-blue rules plus tightly grouped elements. The user specifically wants subtle BORDERED CARDS for previous/next collection links. These cards have the SAME background as the page, no colored fill or shadow.
Portrait composition approximately1050x1700, screenshot of website ONLY. Header and second nav row identical in size and positioning to Image1. No measurements or explanatory labels in the image.
Content below navigation:
Top-left small back arrow and exact "返回", font13, 24px below navigation; 16px after back row then metadata "长文 · 2026.10.11" font12/18.
Title "示例系列 · 第一话", 28px/38 semibold, 6–8px below metadata.
One quiet metadata row "#demo   合集：示例系列", 12px/18, 8px below title.
Body exactly "这是示例系列的第一篇正文。" in16px/28, 20px below title metadata. Do not invent additional article paragraphs, subtitles or content.
Then 28px breathing room and a faint horizontal rule; 20px below rule a compact collection heading row: left "继续阅读" 15px semibold, right small link "示例系列 ↗" 12px in steel blue.
12px below heading show TWO equal cards SIDE BY SIDE, with12px gap, border1px #DFEAF0, radius10px, padding14px, each about88px tall. This remains two columns in this one fixed-width concept; never stack them as the old screenshot.
Left card: small muted label "上一篇"; next line "已是合集第一篇" 13px muted, clearly unavailable (no active chevron). Right card: small "下一篇 →"; next line "示例系列 · 第二话" 15px medium dark-blue, clearly clickable. Do not add massive background panels surrounding the section.
24px after cards, a very subtle full-width hairline then24px breathing room to comments heading "评论" 18px/26 semibold.
Below it 12px gap to compact line "登录 后参与评论" with "登录" as a small blue text link, font14. Then a clean modest empty message "还没有评论。" 14px secondary, spaced24px below, NOT a huge bordered empty card, not a gray filled panel.
Keep clear section hierarchy and comfortable readable article text, without the giant 60–100px blanks of the prior version. No stark dark horizontal rules, no fake numbers, no app shell. Use exact Chinese text.
